info.description: T30: Health through Booking and Payment. Customer1 (seed 101) is read-only in this collection; every write flow uses the newly registered postman customer, preserving TC14 for T31.

exec: pm.test('201 active customer', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.environment.set('newCustomerId', d.userId); });

item.name: GET customer1 by Auth user ID
Replay booking same key and body

exec: pm.test('200 const x=pm.response.json();const items=x.data.items||x.data;const o=items.find(v=>v.booking.bookingId===pm.environment.get(bookingId));pm.expect(o).to.exist;pm.environment.set(offerId,o.offerId);',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);const x=pm.response.json();const items=x.data.items||x.data;const o=items.find(v=>v.booking.bookingId===pm.environment.get('bookingId'));pm.expect(o).to.exist;pm.environment.set('offerId',o.offerId);});

item.name: TC28 Customer cannot set driver status
TC30 Reuse key with changed body
TC29 Login rate limit, then health

request.description: Final request. Newman delay 800ms makes 100 sequential logins exceed the 60s fixed window, so each iteration sends three extra invalid logins. Wait at least 65 seconds before the next full run. Restore RATE_LIMIT_LOGIN_PER_MIN=5 in T36.

exec: const n=Number(pm.environment.get('loginRateCount')||0)+1;pm.environment.set('loginRateCount',String(n));const limit=Number(pm.environment.get('rateLimitLogin')||100);if(pm.response.code===429){pm.test('429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('RATE_LIMITED');pm.expect(Number(pm.response.headers.get('Retry-After'))).to.be.above(0);});pm.sendRequest(pm.environment.get('baseUrl')+'/health',(e,r)=>{pm.test('health unaffected by limiter',()=>{pm.expect(e).to.eql(null);pm.expect(r.code).to.eql(200);});});postman.setNextRequest(null);}else{pm.test('bad login rejected before limit',()=>pm.expect([400,401]).to.include(pm.response.code));pm.expect(n).to.be.below(limit+2);for(let i=0;i<3;i++)pm.sendRequest({url:pm.environment.get('baseUrl')+'/auth/login',method:'POST',header:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:{mode:'raw',raw:JSON.stringify({identifier:'postman-invalid@example.test',password:pm.environment.get('invalidPassword')})}},()=>{});postman.setNextRequest('TC29 Login rate limit, then health');}
